ceiling_directive: Prove the effective-compatible-density statement with a computable vanishing ledger, derive unconditional CertGluePFL termination from it, and demonstrate the resulting receipts on the four-label benchmark.
improvement_directive: Complete simultaneous effective compatible density across the full recession-incidence diagram by proving the five listed safety, collar, tail, and refinement-schedule obligations with an input-computable modulus. Then instantiate the construction to close the four-label primal-dual gap to at most 0.001 with every error charge included.
critique: The unconditional results establish atomic dual exhaustion, local smoothing and averaging inequalities, compact Carter transfer, coordinatewise causal endpoint attainment, and windowed minimax convergence, but they do not establish the advertised quantitative recession-gluing construction. Effective compatible density is left open, so CertGluePFL termination, replayable moving-offset Gaussian rules, and global certified upper bounds remain conditional; only a global liminf and a window-restricted two-sided limit are proved. The four-label test still has the very wide certified interval [0.361100, 0.813799], so the proposed certification method lacks even its stated bounded-instance validation. The framing does not falsely call these conditional conclusions proved, but the delivered package remains a companion/setup contribution rather than the field-level effective algorithm and global compatibility theorem suggested by the research object. Its breadth, conditional centerpiece, and absence of a working certificate materially constrain the leading-journal score. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.4 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
